items.title: George Shearing interviewed by Joe Williams, New York City, New York, March 8, 1996
items.q: And in comes Louis you know. “Oh,” he said, “dig old Shearing getting in on the freebies there.”

ctx.x: I’ll never forget one wonderful thing with Louis Armstrong. I had the quintet in the — I want to say Casino Theater in Toronto. And around the corner from there was a restaurant and I took the guys to dinner. And everything had sauce upon sauce upon sauce. So I ate the banana fritters, which was the only plain thing I could find. And in comes Louis you know. “Oh,” he said, “dig old Shearing getting in on the freebies there.” He said, “That cat’s eating so fast he looks like he’s smiling.”
Oh, Louis was a great tease.
